message.content:
1. (HIGH) — Module 4 / Compressor Assembly
   Finding: Compressor respects brief (R290-rated Copeland PFJ-coded single-phase 230 V unit) but part number format is non-standard and unverified.
   Evidence: "A Copeland r290 scroll compressor (part YP-PFJ series), rated 230 V 1-phase 50 Hz"
   Root cause: Stage 2.4 compressor selection / energy_conversion_transduction.json
   Fix: Change part to verified Copeland ZP24K5E-PFJ-800 (or equivalent 50 Hz PFJ variant) and update BoM line.

2. (HIGH) — Module 6 / Fan Impeller
   Finding: Outdoor fan correctly uses specified ebm-papst HyBlade A5D500 axial 450-500 mm unit delivering >3000 m³/h.
   Evidence: "A ebm-papst axial fan blade (part HyBlade A5D500 family, 450-500 mm diameter) (additional: performance: e3,000 m³/h)"
   Root cause: Stage 2.6 fan selection / actuation_kinematics.json
   Fix: No change required; lock this exact family in prompt for future iterations.

3. (MED) — Module 4 & 9 / Refrigerant path seals
   Finding: Refrigerant-wetted seals correctly mandate HNBR/PTFE and prohibit EPDM for R290 compatibility.
   Evidence: "All refrigerant lines use 15 mm OD copper tubing with HNBR seals at every joint" and "mandating HNBR or PTFE elastomers while explicitly prohibiting EPDM seals"
   Root cause: Stage 2.4 / 2.9 material rules / energy_conversion_transduction.json + safety_protection.json
   Fix: Add explicit regex filter in prompt to reject any remaining EPDM lines in refrigerant sub-modules.

4. (HIGH) — Module 8 / Main controller board
   Finding: Controller family correctly uses STM32F0/L0 as required (not F407).
   Evidence: "built around the STMicroelectronics STM32F0/L0 family MCU running at 48 MHz with 256 KB flash and 32 KB RAM"
   Root cause: Stage 2.8 controller selection / control_compute_communication.json
   Fix: No change required; add hard constraint "STM32F0 or STM32L0 only" to future prompts.

5. (HIGH) — Appendix A / G5 verification
   Finding: G5 unverified count jumped from 0 to 81 because iteration 4 introduced many new custom-fabricated SKUs and non-standard part numbers that failed catalogue lookup.
   Evidence: "81 part numbers could not be verified against DigiKey / Mouser / Farnell / web — manual sourcing required" and "Stripped (fakes): 81"
   Root cause: Stage 4.5 part-number verification / BoM emitter after adding 10 new design decisions and expanded sub-modules
   Fix: Add pre-verification step that rejects any part number containing "ASHP-", "custom", or non-catalogue formats before BoM emission.

6. (HIGH) — Cost Stack / BoM summary
   Finding: Raw BoM £2044.77 (installed ASP £3992) remains >2× the £1800 target because of excessive custom fabricated parts, oversized safety components, and lack of cost-down iteration.
   Evidence: "Raw materials BoM £2,044.77" and "£499 per kW thermal installed"
   Root cause: Stage 6 BoM emitter / cost_stack.py with no active £1800 ceiling constraint after brief update
   Fix: Re-run with explicit "target raw BoM ≤ £900, halve custom fab lines, substitute lowest-cost catalogue equivalents" instruction and add cost critic gate.

7. (HIGH) — Physics critic / Appendix B
   Finding: New high-severity errors introduced this iteration (absent in iter-3): grossly undersized SWEP B5T-20 condenser and truncated JSON payload in safety module.
   Evidence: "[high/high] engineering_plausibility @ energy_conversion_transduction/sub_modules[1]/words[0]: The SWEP B5T-20 (10-plate...) is extremely undersized for an 8 kW condenser"
   Root cause: Stage 3.2 physics critic run after design expansion without size re-calculation
   Fix: Add explicit condenser sizing formula (min 0.5 m² active area for 8 kW) and full-payload validation gate before final emission.
